items.title: Jackie Cain and Roy Kral interviewed by Monk Rowe, New York City, New York, March 22, 1998
items.q: we meet him, and we talked and finally he said well do a couple of things... we did this one song... Alec sat down in a sofa with his back to us... he said, 'well Roy changes my chords but usually they’re for the better.'

ctx.x: And a great writer, great writer, and he’s interested in everything. He’s interested in people, and of course he loved Alec Wilder so the minute we see him we talk about Alec Wilder and all the friends of ours that we have that are mutual friends. Fun.
Tell me about “East of Suez” and how that was conceived. Is the arrangement that you did on—
